title: Training Notes: The Day a Home Purchase Agreement Closing Extension Counts From
content:
**Q. From which day is a buyer closing extension on a Home Purchase Agreement counted?**
It depends on what the agreement ledger already shows:

1. Where the ledger carries closing delay per diem whose latest delay period ends on or after the scheduled closing date, the extension counts from the last day of that per diem period.
2. Where no per diem has been charged, the scheduled closing date has passed and the home's estimated completion date falls after the scheduled closing date, the extension counts from the estimated completion date.
3. Otherwise the day the extension counts from is not moved by these entries.

**Q. What is "the latest delay period"?**
Among the closing delay per diem charges on the agreement ledger, the one whose period ends latest; its last day is the period end date shown on that charge.

**Q. When has the scheduled closing date "passed"?**
When the current date is after the scheduled closing date. On the scheduled closing date itself it has not passed.

**Q. Can both 1 and 2 apply?**
No. Item 2 requires that no per diem has been charged at all, and item 1 requires that one has.

**Check yourself (hypothetical agreement, scheduled closing date 1 May).**

| Ledger and dates | Extension counts from |
|---|---|
| Per diem charged for 2 May to 11 May | 11 May |
| Per diem charged for 2 May to 6 May and for 7 May to 11 May | 11 May (the latest period) |
| Per diem charge whose period ended 25 April | Not moved by these entries (the latest period ends before 1 May, and a per diem has been charged) |
| No per diem; today is 15 May; estimated completion date 8 May | 8 May |
| No per diem; today is 15 May; estimated completion date 28 April | Not moved by these entries |
| No per diem; today is 1 May; estimated completion date 8 May | Not moved by these entries (the date has not passed) |
